The offsets are a permutation of (2,-1,-1) at each outer site and all zero centrally. Each displayed cap has mass V+(2/3)^2 V=13V/9, their margins sum to zero, and the central section has barycentric centroid (1/3,1/3,1/3). For these unnormalized margins the exact threshold coarea is 4V/3, from the derivative of V(1-t)^2 at t=1/3. Thus the three response weights are equal.

For every through-mark normal the centroid lower bound gives at least 4V/9 centrally, or the entire central fiber for a pure-base cap. On an edge, W=1/3 plus 1/3 times the middle-third indicator centrally and W=1/3 at each outer site. The central source excess is 16σ/13-σ=3σ/13. The outer deficit is σ/13 per site, and the squared base norms 2,1,1 give 4σ/13. Weighting by h_{K-g} is constant on every transported normal. The divergence integrands 2 and 3x-g give total 2V and first moment 2Vg for the weighted edge law, hence centroid g for each outgoing outer component. Full retained mass and projective energy at those interior centroids both equal V.
